rules.normative_text: Red Team outputs follow one provider-neutral schema: exact reviewed head SHA, scope reviewed, decision from the closed set APPROVED, CHANGES_REQUESTED, or BLOCKED, findings with evidence identifiers, reviewer role with an explicit independence disclosure, review date, conditions, forbidden-scope confirmation, and the SHA-bound statement. Provider-specific adapters may extend but must not redefine the core schema.

A Red Team decision applies only to its listed head SHA and is stale on any head change. A reviewer that is not independent of the implementation must disclose that non-independence in the reviewer-role field; an undisclosed non-independent review is contract-invalid.
